established: Observation of this S24, one run: the loader's resume at assembly checkpoint 5 worked. After the MMU-off branch to site5-28 the kernel's own MMU-enable block ran again, the kernel read slot[2] = 11 and did not stop at checkpoint 5 again, and its start code, arm_init, cpu_data_init and PE_init_platform ran to loader_checkpoint(11): the first C-level XNU execution on the device.

The kernel's state at C checkpoint 11 equals the NAT-033 model in every register the report carries (x0, x1, x2, x3, TTBR0, TTBR1, TCR lo32, VBAR lo16); SCTLR_EL1 differs only in bits 5 and 7, as in run 008. The model predicted this arrival state and was right.

The loader's return stub works from a C checkpoint on hardware: loader_jump entered it through its private TTBR0 with the MMU on (SCTLR M = 1 as read), and it drew the full report, including the DECON0 block and a second round up to the watchdog. Whether the prologue's MMU-off was needed cannot be told: the stub, stack and log lie in the same 2 MiB block at the measured base.
The slot[2] write with the cache maintenance order of nat034_set_next was visible to the kernel after the MMU-on (the kernel did not stop at 5 again).
No exception report, no panic/return report and no FAIL frame; the panic path (loader_return, psci_smp_stop_others, redwood_*_quiesce) was not exercised.
S-Boot started this loader Image at 0x80180000.
not_established: Anything the kernel does after C checkpoint 11: the stop is final and not resumable (loader_jump leaves the kernel's C path); the other 22 C checkpoints, kernel_bootstrap, the scheduler, drivers, interrupts, timers and the GPU were not reached or not observed.
The kernel logged nothing before checkpoint 11 (x1 = 0, loader_log_len 0), so no kernel log text exists; a transport that does not depend on a camera is not built.
Whether the cache-maintenance order in nat034_set_next is minimal or correct in general: only that it worked in this run.
The SCTLR bits 5/7 cause (hypothesis: architecture-fixed on a core without AArch32 EL0; not checked against the Arm ARM).

boot_args and the ADT as seen by the kernel beyond the fact that PE_init_platform returned and checkpoint 11 was reached; the panic-path MMIO hazard of decision 0017 is untested because no panic occurred.
Who entered Download Mode (device 70 at +120 s was not identified by iProduct) is not established.
